proposed_sites.reason: Module-level assignment to openai.api_key must become explicit client construction, e.g. client = OpenAI(api_key=...)
openai.ChatCompletion.create is a v0.x namespaced module-level call; must become client.chat.completions.create(...).

considered_and_rejected.reason: The bare 'import openai' statement itself remains valid syntax/text in v1.x; it does not need its own text changed to fix the migration (only the downstream usages at lines 8 and 48 require edits).

Reflects v0.x dict-style response access (v1.x returns a pydantic object, e.g. output.choices), but this is not one of the 3 enumerated patterns (no namespaced module call, no openai.error reference, no auth attribute assignment), so it falls outside the scope of this audit.
